vietnam-last.jpg.file: File:The last known photo of Lauri Törni in Vietnam.jpg
vietnam-last.jpg.description: The last photo of Lauri Törni on October 15, 1965, three days before his death. A reconnaissance team is about to depart on a mission from Kham Duc. Pictured are Vietnamese helicopter pilots, Patrol Leader Charles Petry, Lieutenant Colonel
